name: Widowers
overview: Scripture emphasizes God's special care and justice for vulnerable individuals, including widows and fatherless children, as seen in commands not to afflict them (Exodus 22:22) and the curse pronounced on those who pervert their judgment (Deuteronomy 27:19). The Psalms highlight God as the defender and judge of widows, preserving and relieving them (Psalms 68:5; 146:9). While the sample includes teachings on marriage and divorce (Matthew 5:32; Mark 10:1), these underscore the sanctity of marriage, which frames the reality of widowhood within God's design for covenant faithfulness.
